description: Integer division truncates when float expected
buggy_code:
def calculate_average(numbers):
    total = sum(numbers)
    count = len(numbers)
    average = total // count  # Bug: integer division
    return average

scores = [85, 90, 78, 92, 88]
avg = calculate_average(scores)
print(f"Average: {avg}")  # Expected: 86.6, Got: 86
traceback:
No exception raised.
Expected output: Average: 86.6
Actual output: Average: 86
The average is truncated to an integer instead of being a float.

ground_truth.root_cause: Uses integer division operator // which truncates the result — should use / for true division to get float result
